verdict.rationale: Mercury's core banking product supports sending domestic ACH and wire payments, evidenced by the CLI's 'payments' and 'recipients' resource commands, AI-assisted bill pay ('approve and pay in seconds'), and community confirmation that wire transfers work reliably over years of use; the REST API also documents ACH initiation. missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation naming 'ACH' or 'wire' payment types with fees/limits, and the hosted MCP server is read-only (no send-money tool), so programmatic payment initiation evidence is thin/indirect.
